notes: The bench judge's expected-verdict roster (tools/benchjudge --roster): membership by cell name, the board-side sibling of the gate's expected-failure test roster. Every cell is judged at the ceiling its bench sidecar declares (general 1.3, text 1.7; tools/benchjudge states both derivations) — this file carries expectations only and can never select a ceiling. `red` cells must be judged and read red at their own ceiling: the counter-red bigroot sweeps whose cures are owned by the C2 kernel flip, the two hugeleaf display rows whose wide-value rendering fits over the general ceiling now that the word-window decode fast path has stripped the small-code overhead from the measurement (owned by the text column's kappa/C2 hand-off; the class question resolves there), plus the permanent schoolbook display tripwire (`display_schoolbook/hugeleaf`, a text-ceiling cell: green means the tripwire went dark). `boundary` cells fit within the fit-noise band of their own ceiling (fit_noise_band in tools/benchjudge states the derivation) and may read either verdict; the set is empty at this tip. The bigroot set and the display pair empty at C3; the schoolbook expectation is permanent. The sampling pin lists both modes because these are exponent-class expectations, which hold under quick and record sampling alike (record-mode wide-pair exponents measured 1.464/2.001, 2026-07-24); the profile and the scale pair stay singly pinned. Membership is pinned by crates/before/tests/bench_judge_roster.rs.
